findings.constraint: num_attention_heads must be divisible by TP(32) so each shard owns whole heads
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 24, or accept replicated attention.

findings.constraint: num_key_value_heads must be divisible by TP(32); GQA/MQA shards KV across the mesh's TP dim
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 24 (e.g. 1, 2, 4, 8), or replicate KV (not supported in tt_transformers).
